timestamp_semantics.rule: Preserve each observed source timestamp field exactly as found; apply no precedence, normalization, or synthesized source_timestamp or effective_source_date.
timestamp_semantics.missing_or_invalid: A missing or invalid timestamp candidate neither rejects nor drops a record; it remains absent or invalid exactly as found in source metadata.
timestamp_semantics.target_updated_at: Target ingestion updated_at is target metadata only and neither replaces nor participates in source equality.

source_wing_to_target_wing.excluded_source_rule: Agent and other-wing records are excluded from target Qdrant import and retained without deletion in the immutable source snapshot and private evidence for separate audit.

legacy_room_label_treatment.rule: Preserve every legacy room value unchanged for imported archive records.
legacy_room_label_treatment.active_semantic_room_effect: Import does not make a legacy archive room an active semantic room.

legacy_archive_label_treatment.source_observation: The inventory reports no suffix-marked *-archive source wings.
legacy_archive_label_treatment.unexpected_or_unbound: Fail closed rather than remapping an unexpected or unbound label.
legacy_archive_label_treatment.target_label_rule: Archive target labels are assigned only by the approved public wing-routing rules.

excluded_source_disposition.rule: Do not import agent or other-wing records into target Qdrant.
excluded_source_disposition.retention: Retain excluded records in the immutable source snapshot and private evidence for separate audit; do not delete them.

preservation_representation.standard_fields: Keep the source identifier, document bytes, and reused vector exact in the standard MemPalace/Qdrant fields.
preservation_representation.operational_metadata: Use a copy of source metadata with only operational wing changed for archive routing; retain original room and every other field unchanged.

source_metadata_copy.collision_rule: Fail closed when source metadata already contains _solidstats_migration.

preservation_representation.parity_rule: Compare nested source_metadata exactly for every imported record.
preservation_representation.independent_safety_copy: Retain the immutable source snapshot and private bundle as independent safety copies.
preservation_representation.duplication_acceptance: Operational metadata and the exact nested source metadata are intentionally duplicated because preventing data loss outweighs avoiding two representations.

archive_immutability_and_recovery.agent_rule: Agents must not write, update, or delete records in *-archive or SolidStats-archive wings.
archive_immutability_and_recovery.adjacent_contract: The cross-repo agent contract will enforce this rule; that adjacent change is deferred and is not edited by this plan.
archive_immutability_and_recovery.recovery_boundary: Recovery relies on the immutable source snapshot, Qdrant snapshots, off-host backups, and tested restore.
archive_immutability_and_recovery.accepted_residual_risk: Residual direct API, token, and software-bug mutation risk is accepted.
